methods.label: Subtraction with borrowing
methods.explanation: There are not enough ones to subtract. Exchange 1 ten for 10 ones, so 52 becomes 4 tens and 12 ones. Taking away the 18 used sheets leaves \(12-8=4\) ones and \(4-1=3\) tens. Thus \(52-18=34\), so 34 sheets remain.
methods.levelReason: Exchanging one ten for ten ones and subtracting by place value fit the supplied Grade 1 scope.

candidate.annotationRationale: Finding the remaining sheets from the total and the used part assesses cnm_p035. The completed method applies that relationship and performs digit-by-digit subtraction with borrowing, matching cnm_p034; cnm_p017 supports its tens-and-ones reasoning locally. The exact two-digit difference also needs the proposed method-neutral target. One completed method is sufficient.
